description: This is the main entry point for a React-based web frontend. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App into the DOM element with id 'root' inside a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering, targeting the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM within the created root.
